summary: Ameren Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that it delivered a notice under its existing Equity Distribution Sales Agreement, increasing the aggregate gross sales price authorized under its equity distribution program by $2,000,000,000. After the increase, up to $2,266,700,000 of common stock remains available for issuance. This is an at-the-market equity program enhancement, not a special situation. The filing includes a legal opinion on share legality. The company has no obligation to sell shares and may suspend offers. No terms such as price per share or premium are relevant. This is routine capital program administration.
